children.design_delta_summary: 1) Replace both parent unknown-pCID extremes with a quarantine/blind-carry policy: unknown envelopes are not accepted as valid messages, but exact bytes may be retained and relayed only as explicitly uninterpreted artifacts. 2) Add a tri-state local outcome model (accepted-known, quarantined-unknown, rejected-malformed) with required local audit records. 3) Remove parent ambiguity by stating unsigned-v0 has exactly two slots and no signature fields; signatures must live in payloads or outer wrappers.

Keeps the minimal positional envelope but combines DAG-CBOR plus opaque unknown handling from one parent with wrapper-selected signatures from the other; adds mandatory local unsupported or malformed envelope receipts so unknown traffic stays auditable without being semantically accepted; adds a stable semantic_id derived from resolved [pcid,payload] so applications can compare meaning across wrappers, carriers, and envelope variants.

acceptance.reviewer_note: Promote nonol under DI-lunuv: simpler pCID/DAG-CBOR unknown-quarantine blind-carry design; reject dubil semantic_id mutation as unnecessary.

culling.reason: Rejected under DI-lunuv: semantic_id is unnecessary extra protocol machinery beside canonical [pcid,payload] CID.
